## graceful-apple

### Description and Rationale
I signed up for this EUROCONTROL PRC event because I am passionate about applying data science and analytics to real-world aviation challenges. I’m excited to work with open data, collaborate with other experts, and tackle complex problems like improving flight predictability and reducing fuel burn. It’s a fantastic opportunity to test my technical skills while contributing to a more efficient and sustainable European air traffic network.
